_comment_modes: Each mode is a client EXE plus the .csgalaxy pass file handed to it as its
single command-line argument — which is all a drag-and-drop ever did.
There are three EXEs today only because the localhost redirect and the
code patches that TestBed needs have not been reconciled into one binary.
When they are, this file is the only thing that changes: point every mode
at the same 'exe' and delete the others from build.ps1's copy list.
needs_server  documentation, not control flow. The launcher always runs
the stub server; this records which modes actually use it.
show          false keeps a mode out of the player-facing window without
